name: novelspell-remix
description: NovelSpell Remix: a fork button for the classics. The Worker (server/) and the static site (site/) are separate npm packages; these scripts run them from the repo root.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix site ci && npm --prefix server ci
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix site run check
scripts.smoke: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
